title: AIOS AutoResearch v0.1 Frozen Batch/Eval Manifest
description: One frozen batch manifest, including explicit split membership (issue #391 offers a single manifest schema as an alternative to a separate split-manifest schema; this repo uses that option to keep the schema set minimal). One batch manifest = one immutable baseline and one frozen evaluator/split/threshold contract (issue #391 Grain). Reuses REGRESSION_GATE.md's baseline contract fields and benchmarks/*/freeze_manifest.json's hash/threshold field names verbatim rather than inventing new ones. Lineage-disjointness across split_membership (train vs. validation/holdout) is NOT expressible in JSON Schema alone and is enforced separately by tests/test_autoresearch_schemas.py and, at runtime, by child #392's validator -- this schema only shapes the data.

status.description: A frozen manifest is never mutated in place; a changed baseline starts a new batch_id/manifest (batch baseline immutability, INV-09).

frozen_hashes.description: sha256, bare hex, matching benchmarks/*/freeze_manifest.json's convention. INV-03: any mismatch at batch start invalidates the batch.

split_membership.description: Explicit split membership by scenario_lineage_id, not case_id, so paraphrased duplicates cannot cross splits. train/validation/holdout must be pairwise disjoint (checked outside JSON Schema, see description above).

variance_rule.description: Field name reused verbatim from benchmarks/live_behavioral/benchmark_spec.json. The specific statistical method is owned by child #395, not this schema.

holdout_sealed.description: true until the predeclared checkpoint (docs/standards/AUTORESEARCH_V01_CONTRACT.md section 10 Phase boundary); reused concept from benchmarks/live_behavioral's sealed_holdout_sha256.
